This caused the loss of cooling for the reactor cores, resulting in meltdowns at three reactors. The hydrogen explosions occurred at the facility further damaged the concrete outer structure and caused the evacuation of occupants within the 20km zone. There were no reports of casualties due to radiation exposure.
